title: Dashboard + pan show render a completed, closed-out issue as never-started (post-close-out history wipe)
body:
## Symptom

Open the issue detail page for a **completed, merged, closed-out** issue (observed: MYN `MIN-929`, closed out 2026-08-01 ~12:27 after full plan → work → review → UAT → merge → deploy). The dashboard shows:

- Pipeline strip: PLAN 08/01 and DONE 08/01 have dates, but **WORK / REVIEW / TEST / SHIP show "—"** despite all having run.
- All four review specialists (`review.security/correctness/performance/requirements`) show **QUEUED — "starts when the convoy slot frees"** — they ran and completed (agent dirs exist: `~/.overdeck/agents/agent-min-929-review-{security,correctness,performance,requirements,supervisor}`).
- **Tasks tab: 0/0** — a finalized xBRIEF exists at `~/.overdeck/state/mind-your-now/specs/2026-08-01-MIN-929-*.xbrief.json`.
- Conversation tab: **"Nothing here yet — no agent has started on this issue."** — `agent-min-929` ran for ~6h.
- Verification gates: **pending** TYPECHECK/LINT/TEST, UAT **unavailable** — the merge commit on both MYN repos is literally `Merge UAT batch uat/min-crow-0801 (MIN-929)` (frontend `e8b6f61b1`, api `74aca935`, prod serving `74aca935`).
- Live activity: "No activity yet."

CLI shows the same amnesia: `pan show MIN-929` → `cv (no work history)`. While the agent was still running it showed `cv 1 total (0 done, 1 active) · 0% success` — 0% for an issue that succeeded.

## Why it's a big deal

The operator looked at this page and concluded the pipeline never planned/ran the issue at all ("I don't think it actually even planned"). A completed issue rendering as never-started destroys trust in every green checkmark the dashboard shows, and inverts reality exactly when the operator is doing a post-hoc audit.

## Evidence that the durable history exists

- `~/.overdeck/state/mind-your-now/records/min-929.json`
- `~/.overdeck/state/mind-your-now/specs/2026-08-01-MIN-929-*.xbrief.json`
- `~/.overdeck/state/mind-your-now/drafts/min-929.md` (full auto-mode PRD with decisions D1–D6)
- `~/.overdeck/agents/{planning-min-929,agent-min-929,agent-min-929-review-*}` with `activity.jsonl`
- Merged commits on both MYN repos' main + Linear close-out with `closed-out` label

## Root-cause pointer (verify, don't assume)

Smells like the issue-detail read path resolves phase history / specialists / tasks / conversation from **live runtime state** (agent state.json, active workspace, convoy slots) rather than from the durable record on `overdeck-state` (`records/<issue>.json`, specs, JSONL transcripts). Close-out archives the workspace and runtime state, so everything the page reads evaporates — violating the single-source-of-truth tenet (read door must resolve from durable records; the DB is a rebuildable cache). The "QUEUED / starts when the convoy slot frees" copy for *finished* reviewers suggests the specialists panel defaults to queued whenever no live runtime entry matches.

## Acceptance

1. A closed-out issue's detail page shows the true phase dates (WORK/REVIEW/TEST/SHIP), completed reviewer states, task counts from the finalized xBRIEF, verification gate outcomes, and the conversation/activity history, all resolved from durable records after workspace archive.
2. `pan show <id>` on a closed-out issue reports the real work history and success rate, never "no work history"/0% for a merged issue.
3. Regression test: close out a fixture issue, then assert the detail resolver returns non-empty phases/specialists/tasks from the record store.
